item.title: This Day in New Jersey History — November 4: Voters approve financing for the Garden State Parkway
item.description: On November 4, 1952, New Jersey voters approved a referendum allowing the Highway Authority to finance construction of the Garden State Parkway with state-backed bonds. Source: Garden State Parkway History (https://gsphistory.njta.gov/)
